phoneNumber.description: This is the phone number that the message is associated with.

timestamp.description: This is the timestamp of the message.

artifact.description:
This is a live version of the `call.artifact`.

This matches what is stored on `call.artifact` after the call.

assistant.description: This is the assistant that the message is associated with.

customer.description: This is the customer that the message is associated with.

call.description: This is the call that the message is associated with.

text.description: This is the text to be synthesized.

sampleRate.description: This is the sample rate to be synthesized.
